passages.quote: Lawes' process for manufacturing superphosphate fertiliser, by treating bones or mineral phosphates with sulphuric acid, was granted a patent (No. 9353) in November 1842.

passages.locator: Timeline entry for 1843, "Establishment of Lawes Manure Company"
passages.quote: Lawes' first factory, which was at Deptford Creek, was opened in 1843.
